  WHY: This relies on both functions remaining in the same shell scope; it is not failing today, but the invariant is unenforced and a future subshell refactor could make the fallback unavailable.

Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/6665\nRefs #6664") Evidence of absence: The PR description contains only the issue reference and `Refs #6664`. It does not enumerate the SHAs of the reviewed commits ported from #6209 (claude_run_selected / claude_engine_stage_support foundation) or from #6615 (fallback alerts). Without that list, the operator cannot verify the ported code matches the previously reviewed commit bytes and cannot tell whether the whole PR was re-applied instead of the approved hunks. SEVERITY: NIT ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- .github/workflows/validation-refresh.yml, "Resolve AI engine" step, line 107 (`ai_engine_stage_support "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}" "${CLAUDE_ENGINE_SUPPORT_DEST}"`) | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Staging engine helpers from the workflow's own checkout bypasses the verified support boundary that the issue spec and the parallel `validate.yml` step enforce.
  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: Add a "Fetch workflow support files" step, export `VALIDATION_REFRESH_HELPER_STAGE_DIR`, and stage from that verified checkout; gate "Install Claude Code CLI" and "Resolve Claude credential" on successful staging.
